availability_audit: CHRONOLOGY-LEGAL FOR ROUTE 102. Everything is a Route101, Route102 or Route103 land encounter plus one C01 starter; the player has walked all three routes by this battle. GROWLITHE, HOOTHOOT, CORPHISH = wild:Route103/land_mons; TIMBURR, PACHIRISU = wild:Route102/land_mons (this battle own route); TREECKO = book C01 starter. Nothing evolved, nothing fished, no legendary/mythical/Ultra Beast/Paradox species.
plan: Three explicit probes plus the crack list. (1) LIGHTNING ROD: Pachirisu NUZZLE is a single-target Electric move with almost no damage cost, so aiming it at Pikachu partner is a near-free test of whether Lightning Rod redirects. (2) WIDE GUARD: Timburr ROCK_SLIDE is the spread attack Paras authored Wide Guard is supposed to answer, so every Rock Slide turn asks that question directly. (3) SPORE: Hoothoot INSOMNIA and Grass-type Treecko are both powder/sleep immune, and Growlithe, Timburr, Pachirisu and Corphish are all legal Spore targets, so the AI always has a legal sleep available. Crack list proper: powder immunity (Treecko, Hoothoot), Volt Absorb Pachirisu as a flat Electric immunity against Volt Tackle and Electroweb, Intimidate against Huge Power Bunnelby, Knock Off against the three Eviolite/Light Ball/Sitrus items, and Psychic/Fairy pressure on Mienfoo substituted with Growlithe Flare Blitz and Hoothoot Air Slash, both super effective on Paras.
